Raising Cane’s at Home 🐔🏠 For ALL of you asking - the app link for Osta is in my bio or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play store ‼️🫶 Crispy buttermilk chicken tenders, addictive Cane’s sauce and fluffy texas toast… all at home!  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Chicken Au Poivre‼️ Full Video Things you need  Whole chicken Sherry Wine (Holland House Cooking Wine) 1 Large Shallot Minced Garlic (3-4 cloves) Heavy Whipping Cream, 2 - 2.5 cups Fresh Cracked Black Pepper Fresh Rosemary, chopped    Chicken Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Paprika, Kinder’s Buttery Poultry Seasoning, Dried Parlsey  Sauce Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder Directions  1. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. Serve Serve the chicken over mashed potatoes or rice, and garnish with parsley. #cookingvideos #chickenaupoivre #recipes #fyp #mashedpotatoes

ONE-PAN CREAMY CHICKEN & CHORIZO PASTA  10/10 – this was absolutely f*cking gorgeous  WHAT YOU’LL NEED: • 650g chicken breast, diced • Cooking spray • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp oregano • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 150g chorizo, skin removed and diced • 1 medium brown onion, diced • 30g tomato purée • 250g dried pasta of choice • 800ml chicken stock • Extra paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tsp garlic granules • 100ml single cream • Fresh chives, to garnish HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Dice 650g of chicken tits and add them to a large bowl. 2. Spray the chicken with cooking spray, then add 2 tsp of paprika, 1 tsp of oregano, 1 tsp of salt and 1 tsp of black pepper. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Make sure every piece is completely coated. 3. Add 150g of diced chorizo to a large pan with no oil and cook until beautifully browned and releasing all that glorious chorizo oil. 4. Add the diced brown onion and cook until softened. 5. Chuck in the seasoned chicken tits and 30g of tomato purée, then cook until the chicken is around halfway cooked. 6. Add 250g of dried pasta and pour in 800ml of chicken stock. Give everything a good stir, cover with a lid and simmer for around 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked and the chicken is completely cooked through. 7. Season again with some extra paprika, oregano, a pinch of salt, a pinch of african american pepper and 1 tsp of garlic granules. Garrrrrlic! 8. Pour in 100ml of single cream and mixy mixy motherf**ker! until everything is coated in that ridiculously creamy chorizo sauce. 9. Divide into 5 portions, finish with some freshly chopped chives and enjoy! Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

WANT MOIST CHICKEN? These are the 2 simple cooking hacks for the juiciest chicken you’ve ever had. I usually do chicken thighs, but this is an amazing way to make regular chicken super moist! You need a little baking soda, to cook with the lid on & let it rest, and you’ll never have dry boring chicken again. Ingredients 2 chicken brst 1 tbsp olive oil 1/4 tsp baking soda 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Juice and zest of 1 small lemon Salt & pepper to taste Optional: 2 tbsp  yogurt Here is how I made it: 1.Add 2 chicken brsts to a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp baking soda to soften up the fibers, the zest & juice of a lemon, and optional: 2 tbsp plain yogurt. Mix well, and make sure the chicken is at room temperature (not cold!) This is important!! 2.Let this marinate for 30 minutes (outside of the fridge). By not using cold chicken, it help cook the chicken evenly. 3.Bring a pan to medium heat. Once it’s hot, place the chicken in the pan. Cover with a lid and cook for 3 mins on the first side. This is going to trap the moisture. 4.After 3 mins, flip it, cover with the lid, reduce heat to MEDIUM-LOW, and let it cook for another 7-8 mins. If you used cold chicken, or if your pan wasn’t hot enough, or if your chicken was too thick, this may require more time (and not be juicy, so follow the directions! 5. After 7-8 minutes remove the chicken from the pan, place it on a cutting board or plate, and let it rest for at least 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the chicken, making it more tender and locking in the juices.   6.After resting, slice the chicken breasts against the grain and serve. You can serve this however way you wish – with your favorite veggies, salad, or with rice, quinoa, or if you’re looking for lowcarb/keto options, my @Kaizen Food Company lowcarb rice. Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1.
